claim: The demo uses separate packet and license storage, never contacts Sociobot, and never changes real packets or licenses.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; create and snapshot a real packet plus real license keys; open /demo; activate a canned sample license, edit, reset, activate again, and exit; assert the real snapshot is byte-identical, all demo stores are removed, and no Sociobot request occurs

claim: The sample opens with two files, four evidence gaps, and two accountant questions.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; open /demo; assert the first visible workspace shows the seeded packet, two attached files, four evidence gaps, and two questions

claim: Packet contents are stored locally and are never uploaded automatically.
where: landing facts, dashboard, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; add a question and attachment; export ZIP; capture the entire flow and assert every request is same-origin

claim: Attachment bytes use device-local AES-256-GCM when Web Crypto is available.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; add known plaintext; inspect the demo IndexedDB record; assert the encrypted flag and absence of plaintext

claim: Exports an accountant ZIP, PDF index, and JSON backup that can be imported.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; inspect ZIP members, PDF signature, and JSON contents; leave demo and import the downloaded backup

claim: The evidence-gap list follows checklist changes.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; assert four seeded gaps; mark one ready; assert that row disappears and three remain

claim: Edits and ZIP export work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; wait for service-worker control; go offline; reload; edit checklist and download a ZIP

claim: One packet is free; a US$12 lifetime license adds unlimited packets and duplication. Checkout opens on Sociobot/Dodo.
where: landing facts, purchase card, terms, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; prove a second packet is gated; assert the Sociobot checkout URL and the US$12 product price source; mock a valid Sociobot verification; prove creation and duplication become available

claim: No account is needed to create and keep a packet in this browser.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; create a packet without any identity or sign-in step; reload and assert it remains

claim: Files up to 25 MB each can be added; larger files are rejected.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; add a 25 MiB file and assert it appears, then add a 25 MiB + 1 byte file and assert rejection

claim: Deadline Packet does not run analytics or advertising trackers.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context through root, demo, and privacy; assert all requests remain same-origin and no analytics or advertising script identifiers are present in the delivered app

claim: Packet data remains until you delete it or clear this site’s browser storage.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; create a packet, reload to prove retention, delete it with confirmation, then clear IndexedDB, Cache Storage, and localStorage and assert no packet returns

claim: Deadline Packet cannot recover local packet data or its browser encryption key after site storage is cleared.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; create a packet with an encrypted attachment; prove the packet, ciphertext, and browser key exist; clear IndexedDB, Cache Storage, and localStorage; assert all three are gone, no recovery action exists, and no recovery request leaves the site

claim: License verification never blocks the free experience.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context with a saved license and a deliberately stalled verification response; assert the free packet interface renders before verification resolves

claim: The app contacts Sociobot only when you buy or verify a lifetime license.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; exercise an unlicensed demo flow, inspect the checkout destination, then verify a saved token while capturing requests and assert only the Sociobot verification endpoint receives the token

claim: Your lifetime-license token and its last check stay in this browser until you remove the license.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context entered through /demo; leave demo, restore a mocked valid license in the real workspace, inspect both real storage keys, reload, remove the license, and assert both keys are gone

claim: Choose your own handoff date.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; create a packet with a chosen date; edit it to 2026-11-20; assert the visible 20 Nov 2026 summary, IndexedDB value, reload summary, and reopened field

claim: Open questions stay beside the files.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; rapidly change a checklist item and add questions, then assert every question is visible beside files before and after reload

claim: Start for real deletes demo changes and opens your real workspace.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; create a real-store marker, edit demo, activate Start for real, and assert demo storage is removed while the real marker remains available

claim: Deadline Packet does not calculate tax.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; inspect the stated capability boundary and assert no calculation action is present

claim: Deadline Packet does not determine legal requirements.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; inspect the stated capability boundary and assert no legal-determination action is present

claim: Deadline Packet does not validate document sufficiency.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; inspect the stated capability boundary and assert no validation action is present

claim: Deadline Packet does not submit returns.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; inspect the stated capability boundary and assert no submission action is present

claim: Deadline Packet does not run OCR.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; inspect the stated capability boundary and assert no scan or OCR action is present
